$comment: Edge treatment: corner radius, plus the border and ring widths the design sanctions. Only `radius` is emitted — Tailwind has no --border-width-* or --ring-* namespace, so border-2 is 2px because the class says so and any integer compiles. The width lists are documentation for the gallery, and cannot be enforced by a token.
$radiusComment: sm..xl are the general rungs. control-* is the form-control ladder from the Soft Fill design — a radius is only legible against the box it rounds, and 3/4/5 belong to boxes of 30/38/46px. control-md duplicating sm's 4px is an alias at the component tier, not a stray literal.
